Name: Jabneel
ModernLocation: Unknown; two towns share the name, one in Judah and one in Naphtali
Description: The name belongs to two towns: one on Judah's northern border and one in Naphtali's allotment. Both appear only in the allotment lists, and neither site is identified.
BiblicalSignificance: Jabneel is shared by a Judah border town and a Naphtali town.
